records.authors: Mahon E, Marsh O, Uriarte A, Stabile F.
records.title: The effect of oral zonisamide treatment on serum phenobarbital concentrations in epileptic dogs.
records.evidence_scope: Direct compound mention; veterinary epilepsy treatment and interaction context.
records.snippet: Zonisamide is used in dogs for the treatment of epileptic seizures.

records.authors: Fischer FP, Karge RA, Koch H, Voigt A, Weber YG, Wolking S.
records.title: The fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster as a screening model for antiseizure medications.
records.evidence_scope: Preclinical antiseizure medication screen; the excerpt names valproate, levetiracetam, and phenytoin.
records.snippet: Treatment with valproate resulted in both a reduction in seizure probability and in seizure duration. In contrast, levetiracetam, brivaracetam and cenobamate had no effect on the bang-sensitive phenotype of eas 2F flies.

records.authors: Mukoyama Y, Ichikawa J, Komori M, Kodaka M, Yokosako S, Kubota Y.
records.title: Novel technique of switching TIVA and sevoflurane during epilepsy surgery for combined intraoperative motor evoked potentials monitoring and electrocorticography: an illustrative case report.
records.evidence_scope: Perioperative anesthesia context; propofol is used during epilepsy surgery, not as an epilepsy treatment.
records.snippet: During epilepsy surgery, ... induction of the total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA) with propofol ... [was] followed by switching to sevoflurane for ECoG recording.

records.authors: Kurnutala LN, Rugnath R, Arora R, Nazari R.
records.title: Anesthetic Management of a Patient With a Vagal Nerve Stimulator and Poorly Controlled Seizures.
records.evidence_scope: Clinical seizure-management and anesthesia context; midazolam and levetiracetam are named, while desflurane is not.
records.snippet: The episode was treated with intravenous levetiracetam ... and selecting anesthetic agents that minimize pro-convulsant potential.

records.authors: Čižmáriková R, Habala L, Valentová J.
records.title: General Anesthetics: Aspects of Chirality, Pharmacodynamics, and Pharmacokinetics.
records.evidence_scope: General-anesthetic class context; the excerpt does not establish an epilepsy indication for fospropofol.
records.snippet: Both inhalational and intravenous anesthetics are discussed. Aspects of pharmacodynamics and pharmacokinetics are surveyed as well.

records.authors: Di Matteo F, Mancuso F, Turcio R, Ciaglia T, Stagno C, Di Chio C, Campiglia P, Bertamino A, Giofrè SV, Ostacolo C, Iraci N.
records.title: KCNT1 Channel Blockers: A Medicinal Chemistry Perspective.
records.evidence_scope: Target-class and drug-discovery context; it does not validate a therapeutic recommendation for this query.
records.snippet: Potassium channels have recently emerged as suitable target for the treatment of epileptic diseases ... [and] the chemotypes described so far as KCNT1 blockers.

records.authors: Checri R, Chipaux M, Ferrand-Sorbets S, Raffo E, Bulteau C, Rosenberg SD, Doladilhe M, Dorfmüller G, Adle-Biassette H, Baldassari S, Baulac S.
records.title: Detection of brain somatic mutations in focal cortical dysplasia during epilepsy presurgical workup.
records.evidence_scope: Disease-gene context for AKT3 and epilepsy; no compound efficacy claim.
records.snippet: We identified low-level mosaic somatic mutations in AKT3 ... and support a link between the mutation load and the epileptic activity.
